title: This is how you get your AI agent a real phone number
description:
xAI's Grok Voice Agent Builder lets you describe an agent in plain English, pick or clone a voice, and provision a real phone number people can call, in about two minutes with no code. You can test it in the browser before it takes a live call. This guide covers the exact agent brief that stops it inventing prices, what it genuinely costs per minute, the 20 test calls to run before going live, and how to package it as a monthly retainer for local businesses.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1I0EhO6C3LIyo0G9d34x-hV56-53LwpFfvuNWYuIIeEc/edit?usp=sharing
